note: PLT-03 path scan exceptions (tools/platform_check.py paths). allowed_absolute: read-only paths anywhere in shipped code. exceptions: one deliberate construct in one file; each must still match something, or the check fails as stale. Rationale in docs/PLATFORM_CHECKS.md.

allowed_absolute.reason: The package's own read-only runtime root (NORDTILE_RUNTIME_ROOT: bundled yt-dlp, resolver, QuickJS, QML, licence notices). Readable inside the sandbox.
The package's own installed icon, read-only.
Kernel interface of the own process (memory, limits). No user data.
System uptime, read by the opt-in start-up trace (SAILTUBE_STARTUP_TRACE) to count from the process start. No user data.

exceptions.reason: Expands a '~/' path the user typed or picked for an import (IMP-01). It reads only that file and stores nothing outside the layout. Under Sailjail it reaches only folders a declared permission opens (see the Downloads sandbox gap).
The '~' and '~/' prefixes recognised by the same import path expansion.
The user name for the SD-card mount root /run/media/<user> (RemovableMedia, DL-06). Not a data path of the app.
QDir::home().dirName(): the same user name when USER is unset. Nothing is read from or written to the home directory.
Deny list: RAM file systems refused as download targets (PLT-09). These paths are compared against, never opened.

ACC-03 (FULL only, listed as lost on STORE): finds the Sailfish Browser profile under the home directory, opens the cookie database read-only and no-follow, and copies it into the app's private 0700 scratch directory before SQLite sees it. Pinned SailTune code; nothing is written outside the layout.
Deny list: RAM-backed trees refused as TMPDIR / media spool (PLT-09). These prefixes are compared against, never opened.
Read-only kernel tables (/proc/net/tcp, tcp6 and the helper's /proc/<pid>/fd) to verify the PO-token helper listens only on 127.0.0.1 (RES-14). Nothing is written.
Read-only system identity files: the PLY-20 hardware probe runs once per device build, keyed on the OS and hardware release. Nothing is written.

ACC-03 (FULL only): the home directory handed to the account's browser import, which probes the three documented Sailfish Browser cookie databases under it, copies the found one with its -wal/-shm into the app's private 0700 scratch directory (AppDataLocation/account/scratch), reads the copy and deletes it. Nothing is read otherwise and nothing is written outside the layout; STORE offers no browser import.
